title: Harley Quinn #68
desc:
THE PITTSTAIN!

My rockin' bod is majorly busted after the events of my latest gallivant around town, but what was supposed to be a nice time of relaxing and recovering at th' hospital has turned into a fiasco of the highest degree!

I got a killer out for my head, and I'm still hooked up to an IV! My life is on the line, and I don't think any doctors are gonna be able to help this time! This hospital sucks! Somebody get my lawyer, Rev. Carl Booger Jr., down here stat—I'm gonna sue!
